m1-regime-rollup-module.title: New src/physics/layer2/regime_rollup.py: corner_bin_share, circuit_distance_share, load_circuit_frame + discriminating unit tests
m1-regime-rollup-module.imperative: Create src/physics/layer2/regime_rollup.py implementing: corner_bin_share(bins_occupied: set[int] | int, n_bins: int = 32) -> float (pure; len(bins_occupied)/n_bins for a set, bins_occupied/n_bins for a count); circuit_distance_share(df_for_circuit: pd.DataFrame, fit: MixtureFit) -> dict computing, per lap-identity group (lap_number plus any of year/session_type/driver/stint_num present in the frame), the fraction of the 32 bins occupied, averaged across laps -> corner_distance_share; straight_distance_share = 1.0 - corner_distance_share; corner sub-shares via corner_descriptors.descriptors_from_frame + property_mixture.posterior_membership on the SAME validity mask descriptors_from_frame uses internally (mu_lat_p90 finite/>0, v_mean finite), n_samples-weighted average membership per class scaled by corner_distance_share so corner_class_i_distance_share values sum to corner_distance_share across classes (document the M=0 / n_samples-sum=0 degenerate fallback); return dict with corner_distance_share, straight_distance_share, corner_class_{i}_distance_share for i in range(fit.k), n_laps, n_rows; load_circuit_frame(db_path: str, gp_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame, a thin READ-ONLY sqlite3 URI (mode=ro) SELECT * FROM grip_bin_obs WHERE gp_name = ? reader with zero computation inside. Module docstring MUST name the computed quantity distance_share (never time_share anywhere in the module) and MUST state explicitly that bin-occupancy distance-share SYSTEMATICALLY UNDERSTATES true time-share for corners (dt = ds/v, lower v in corners means more real time per unit distance than distance-share implies). Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_regime_rollup.py: TDD red first (write tests, observe failing via manual run, attest c1 as red evidence) covering corner_bin_share (set and count forms), circuit_distance_share on synthetic multi-lap fixtures with a known/controlled bin-occupancy pattern and a small synthetic MixtureFit (assert corner_class_i shares sum to corner_distance_share, assert straight+corner sum to 1.0, assert n_laps/n_rows correctness, assert no field is literally named time_share anywhere in the returned dict keys or module source), and a DB-fixture smoke test for load_circuit_frame (build a tiny temp sqlite db with a grip_bin_obs table + a couple of rows, assert the loader returns exactly those rows for the right gp_name and is read-only against a separate connection).

m3-build-script-real-run.title: New scripts/build_regime_rollup.py; real-store run producing regime_time_share.csv + F12-verdict metadata; Monza/Monaco evidence

Run it for real against C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/damage_integrals.db (mixture fit over 612,615 rows may take a couple of minutes -- this is expected). Capture the full stdout transcript, the CSV's first few rows plus the Italy (Monza) and Monaco rows specifically, and the meta content, as command-output evidence. State plainly in the imperative's evidence whether Italy's (Monza's) corner_distance_share < Monaco's on the real run, and that the CSV's own output visibly carries the F12 FAIL verdict.
